_doc: Canonical media verbs (SPEC §7G.1). Ports embed this table verbatim: verb order, tool names, descriptions, normalised args, types and required flags are byte-contract. A tool's schema lists only the args its first supporting client accepts, in this order; required = that client's required args (for a style: this list's required ∩ mapped, plus the style verb's own required).

verbs.description: Generate an image from a text prompt.
Generate a short video from a prompt, optionally starting from an image. Can take minutes.

args.name: prompt
args.description: What should happen in the video.

args.name: image
args.description: URL or local path of the starting image.

verbs.description: Speak text aloud and return the audio.

args.name: voice
args.description: Voice name or id, including a cloned voice.

verbs.description: Generate music from a text prompt and return the audio.

args.name: prompt
args.description: Style, mood and instruments of the music.

verbs.description: Transcribe speech in an audio file to text.

args.name: audio
args.description: URL or local path of the audio.

args.name: language
args.description: Language of the speech as an ISO 639-1 code, e.g. en.

verbs.description: Create a cloned voice from audio samples and return its voice id.

args.name: samples
args.description: URLs or local paths of audio samples of the voice.

verbs.description: Make the person in an image speak, from speech audio or from text (lip-synced video).

args.name: image
args.description: URL or local path of the face image.

args.name: audio
args.description: URL or local path of the speech audio.

args.name: text
args.description: Text to speak when no audio is given.
